skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts of supply and demand, and their impact on investment decisions.
Apply economic principles to make informed investment decisions.
Analyze the behavior of businesses and markets in investment activities.
Grasp the concept of economic cycles and their influence on investment decisions.
Evaluate macroeconomic policies and their impact on investment behavior.
Understand the nature of international capital flows and their global movement.
Develop research skills to analyze and synthesize issues related to investment.
Analyze policies related to investment and understand regulatory measures.
Work independently and collaboratively to solve investment-related problems.
Possess the ability to learn independently, seek information, and complete assignments.
Demonstrate discipline, enthusiasm, teamwork, and responsibility towards work.
Apply critical thinking to identify and resolve issues in the field of investment.
Collaborate effectively with peers to address investment-related challenges.
